title: [dev] Missing BG Value Upload
body:
AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-e
In earlier versions of the Nightscout configuration, the upload of BG values to Nightscout was at the second point.
Now the menu item has disappeared. Rearranged ?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43376497/207393965-598b6e55-58e9-4a99-b588-84f7567adbea.jpeg)

comments.body: it's in BG source preferences. The reason of removal from here was this feature is not available for all bg sources
With fsl2 and xdrip the preference menu is disabled so my bg are not upload to ns
I use Juggluco to send the values to Aaps. This is done via the xdrip Broadcase Channel. Now I have no possibility to send the values to Nightscout.
xDrip is treated as BG source with upload capability thus this option is missing in AAPS
@sfriedriszik then xdrip can upload the data or?
@MilosKozak I don't use xdrip. I use Juggluco with connection to Aaps. Juggluco uses the xdrip broadcast to transfer the data to Aaps.
if you install xdrip it will receive the data as well
@MilosKozak  I know that. I don't want to install xdrip. that worked great before. the diabox users have the same problem.
you may ask juggloco devs to create a special broadcast to aaps
